facts.text: John finds Aragorn's bravery, selflessness, and down-to-earth attitude inspiring.

evidence.quote: Aragorn's brave, selfless, down-to-earth attitude is what inspired me. He never gives up and always stands up for justice.

facts.text: Tim appreciates the immersive experience of fantasy books like LOTR, particularly the attention to detail in world-building.

evidence.quote: What's awesome about fantasy books like LOTR is getting lost in another world and seeing all the tiny details.

facts.text: John finds the map of Middle-earth from LOTR helpful in imagining the world of the story.

evidence.quote: Love this map, it really helps you get lost in another world.
It's a map of Middle-earth from LOTR - it's really cool to see all the different realms and regions.
